english.title: Goods vehicle driver fail to return record book

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employee-driver in whose driver's record book all the weekly record sheets had been used, failed to return the book to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), your employer, as soon as was reasonably practicable after the expiry of a period of 14 days from **(..SPECIFY DATE..), the date on which the book was last returned to you
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(3) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) See offence wording H3312 for employer failing to return book to driver.
(ii) See offence wordings H2664, H2665 and H3290 for employer failing to examine weekly record sheet/detach duplicate record sheet.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wording: H3291.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was employed by **(..SPECIFY EMPLOYER..) as a driver of a goods vehicle, and was the holder of a driver's record book in which all the weekly record sheets had been used, failed to return the record book to that employer after the expiry of 14 days from the date upon which it was last returned by the employer.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
